extraction.Name: Charles Arcoren
extraction.Buyer: Deeded to Clement Valandra for $5000.00 (as a holding arrangement), then sold to Ella McHenry; land was later recovered through lawsuit filed by father and resold a second time by father
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: when the cost of the suit was paid, the taxes and so forth there was only about $400 left and my father got that
extraction.NOTES: Allottee was supposed to get $8500 but only received $1500 at time of sale and small payments afterwards amounting to about $2300; deed to Clement Valandra was a holding arrangement only until sale to Ella McHenry could be completed; father filed suit against McHenry and recovered the land, then resold it; allottee had given land over to father to handle; Clement gave allottee a check for $5000 which Clement said was no good and not to cash; allottee states he did not sign a receipt for the patent; did not make application for the patent; patent delivered in 1920 at home by his father; has four children; notarized March 25, 1929
